data.synopsis:
As heavy snow blanketed the gates, demonic cultivators launched a surprise attack, slaughtering the entire Mo Sect. The young Lu Chaoge lost his closest relatives in the tragedy. Facing certain death, he awakened to a system that defied the heavens, narrowly escaping death through water-elemental spiritual awakening, and vowed to purge the world of demons and evil. 

After a decade of seclusion and arduous cultivation, he remained stuck at the Initial Realm, unable to make any progress. One day, a chance opportunity reactivated the system. He set out from the mountain with his younger sister, Lu Dongli, in search of spiritual herbs to break through his cultivation barrier. Along the way, he ingeniously solved a challenge posed by a strange beast, defied the heavens to summon nine Celestial Decrees to awaken his spiritual power, and broke through five cultivation realms in succession. He even faced down a challenge from a prodigy of the Sword Sect. The once-useless sect master thus began a powerful comeback.

(Source: Yuewen, translated)

data.synopsis:
The Three Kingdoms Trilogy tells the story of the warlords vying for supremacy at the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, culminating in the Battle of Red Cliffs and the division of the realm into three parts.

As the first installment of the Three Kingdoms trilogy, this film marks the beginning of a chaotic era: at the end of the Eastern Han dynasty, before the curtain rises, the Yellow Turban Rebellion rises, imperial relatives seize power, and eunuchs cause political chaos. During the turmoil of the realm, Cao Cao and Yuan Shao sought to use the power of Grand General He Jin to check the eunuchs and support the Han dynasty. Unexpectedly, Dong Zhuo took advantage of the chaos to enter the capital, plotting to depose and enthrone. Amid the turbulent times, heroes such as Yuan Shu, Lü Bu, Sun Jian, and Liu, Guan Wan, and Zhang Fei all rose to prominence. The turmoil in Luoyang erupted, and the fate of the Han dynasty reached a crossroads...... 

(Source: Douban, translated)

data.synopsis:
The immortal stone of Flower-Fruit Mountain transformed into a monkey. Wukong, to protect his clan, traveled far to Fangcun Mountain on the spiritual platform to learn the arts, mastering the seventy-two transformations and somersaults. Due to framing by fellow disciples and violating the Heavenly Law, the Heavenly Court besieged Flower-Fruit Mountain, leaving his home in ruins. Wukong seized the Golden Cudgel and destroyed the Book of Life and Death, protecting the tribe. The Heavenly Court offers amnesty to Feng Bima Wen, Wukong is humiliated and proclaims himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven; The Peach Banquet was once again marginalized, leading to a havoc in the Heavenly Palace. He defeated the Giant Spirit God and Nezha, fought Erlang Shen to a draw, and was thrown into the Bagua Furnace by the Supreme Lord Laozi, who then reversed his skills into the Fiery Golden Eye. After breaking the furnace, he swept through the Lingxiao Palace, and the Buddha suppressed it beneath the Five Elements Mountain. Five hundred years later, Wukong has awakened to his true self, quietly awaits Tang Sanzang's rescue, and will ultimately embark on the path of transformation from demon king to great sage. 

(Source: Douban, translated)
